title: Andrija Puharich, the Ossining 'space kids' and the Council of Nine
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Andrija Puharich, the Ossining 'space kids' and the Council of Nine, about 1950s-1970s at Ossining, New York, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he's the the father of kind of a lot of CIA mind control stuff in MK Ultra but he's bumping into non-human intelligences and having these quote unquote space kids in Austining New York channel

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, drawing on Greg Malazi, Dan Sherman and a book called Mind Traveler, talks about a man named Andrija Puharich, whom he calls a father of much of MK Ultra, the CIA's secret mind control research. Michels says that between the 1950s and the 1970s Puharich came into contact with non-human intelligences, including a group called the Council of Nine, and worked with so-called space kids in Ossining, New York, who channeled their messages. If true, it would mean the intelligence world was in touch with non-human beings through human go-betweens.
